prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic golden-hour garden fashion portrait with navy plaid coquette styling and a calm protected big-cat presence.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional blonde woman with soft waves, pearl choker and earrings, secure navy-and-white plaid puff dress with opaque navy tights and glossy navy heels, standing upright with a relaxed graceful posture beside a calm black jaguar lying on the grass; no touching or restraint.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level 35mm garden portrait, manicured hedges, mature trees, stone tiger statue, tiered dolphin fountain, warm meadow palette, woman and jaguar separated by safe space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural golden-hour sunlight, warm glow on skin and hair, detailed grass and animal coat, gentle background roll-off.
prompt.technical_specs: RAW photorealism, f/2.8, realistic hands, fabric, pearls, foliage, water and animal anatomy, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic golden-hour garden fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional blonde woman with pearl jewelry, secure navy-and-white plaid puff dress, opaque navy tights and glossy navy heels, standing upright with a relaxed graceful posture beside a calm black jaguar lying on the grass with safe space between them, manicured hedges, stone statue, tiered fountain, 35mm f/2.8, warm natural light, realistic texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sheer stockings, sexualized bent-over pose, animal distress, touching or restraining big cat, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
